Class ConceptMapRelationship

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap.ConceptMapRelationship
public final class ConceptMapRelationship extends Object
The R5 ConceptMapRelationship codes that a concept map relation carries, and the conversion of an R4 equivalence to one of them.
